runs.box: OUT AT Q1; INTEGRITY FACTS RECORDED, NOT JUDGED
runs.entry: Price **$2.21** (close 2026-10-16, aggregator, flagged). Shares 7,097,573 on the cover of the 10-Q to 2026-06-30 (0001493152-26-038439; `Screens/cover_shares.py` agreeing, equal to the balance sheet and to the S-3/A of 2026-10-02, no treasury shares), plus 300,000 pre-funded warrants at $0.0001: **7,397,573** used, a CONVENTION of the run; 3,600,000 $5.00 warrants and 1,746,186 options beside. Sovereign **5.43%**, US Treasury 30-year par yield of 2026-10-16 (issuing authority). Read from the 10-K for 2025 (0001493152-26-014356; Item 1A omitted by the filer as a smaller reporting company, risk factors read in the 424B4 of 2026-02-20, 0001493152-26-007618), the two 2026 10-Qs, the 10-Ks for 2024 and 2023 (cash flow statements), the DEF 14C information statements (no proxy statement exists; the company acts by written consent) and the 2024 to 2026 8-Ks; cash at 2025-12-31 $401,203 checked to the filed balance sheet. `tools/run.py` owner-earnings window stops at 2018 (no capital-spending tag read later); owner cash taken from the filed cash flow statements; 2021 an XBRL transcription, confessed. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Item 1, Item 7, the 424B4's risk factors (Item 1A omitted) and the latest 10-Q's notes, stated in the run file. **Q1 OUT**: a start-up on its own 10-K ('development-stage', 'have not commenced commercial operations and have not generated revenue', no offtake agreements, no binding contracts, an eight to nine year pipeline), its business a set of project rights bought from an entity formed twenty days earlier; the first revenue, $7.9M in the quarter to 2026-06-30, is development fees from contributing three projects to the Cerberus-affiliated joint venture, a developer selling rights, not the operator Item 1 describes; OUT on the start-up item of Q1's OUT list **[L2007-015]**, **[M2008-088]**, the TOO HARD (NATURE) reading **[L2000-026]**, **[L1993-023]** considered and not chosen. Q2 to Q12 not reached. After the stop, not weighed: balance sheets 2017 to 2026-06-30 (a shrinking medical-services registrant, a 2021 reverse acquisition, a shell, then a $22.2M intangible booked in 2024 at the market value of shares issued for rights assigned to Emergen the day before 'with no cost basis'); cash $9.38M and no borrowing at 2026-06-30, almost all from the February 2026 offering; about $126M of contingent development fees owed to Energy Independent Partners, controlled by co-chief executive Cole Johnson, plus 62.5% of sale proceeds and acceleration on his removal; 2024 solar projects sold to Bridgelink, whose sole member is his holding company; a $50M capital condition 'negotiated out'; five auditor engagements in two years, four late-filing notices, material weaknesses, a restated 2023, an 'indefinite-lived' intangible amortized into cost of revenue in 2026; a $3.56M GridSpan advance refundable if conditions are unmet by 2027-03-31; contrary evidence written down (the Cerberus affiliate's cash, $3.4M by 2026-06-30 and $3.0M on 2026-07-15; Q2 2026 net income $1.63M; RelyEZ's $10M into GridSpan); integrity facts recorded, not judged. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after stock pay and project-rights spending -$0.30M (2021) to -$3.25M (2025), five-year mean **-$1.38M a year**, H1 2026 -$6.33M; value range the no-growth cases only, **-$2.17 to -$1.33 a share all-equity**, -$3.44 to -$2.59 equity-only; fair price **-$0.37 all-equity, not positive**, -$1.64 equity-only. Contamination declared by the analyst: the opening commit subjects (BLDP TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q1, seen before Q1 was written, declared so a reader can weigh priming; AXIAY), the git status file list, memory index lines, and an interactive session's commit fc7b8b32 (fold mechanics, no company) appearing mid-run; a filename filter of `Test Runs/` for this name returned nothing; none used. Commits ef9736a1 (template), d4f2233b (Step 0, foundations, standing rule), c10ea77c (Q1), cf1229a9 (box, after the stop, computation, self-audit, gaps). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_cites.py` 22 ids, 0 problems; the dispatcher's `_dispatcher_cite_check.py` no missing id, 20 adjacent quoted fragments, **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) Q1 lists start-ups under OUT while section I sends unforeseeable economics and fast-changing fields to TOO HARD (NATURE); a pre-revenue developer in a young field fits both, so the text should say which governs; (2) Q7's specifics (b) and (e) do not fit together when every year's owner cash is negative (the analyst made the maintenance-only case the top and the all-spending case the bottom); (3) the template asks for the proxy and this company files none. Formatting noted by the dispatcher: Q1's numbered tests run 1 to 6 then 9. Not armed: box OUT at Q1. Could not get: the joint venture's earnings (the 7.5% stake credited at nothing); the 2021 line not read in the document.
runs.narr: Development-stage battery-storage and solar developer, no operating project, no binding contract, no offtake; OUT at Q1 on the start-up item **[L2007-015]**, **[M2008-088]**, TOO HARD (NATURE) considered; related-party development fees of about $126M to the co-chief executive's company and five auditor engagements in two years recorded after the stop, not judged; COMPUTATION owner cash -$1.38M a year, range -$2.17 to -$1.33 a share all-equity against $2.21, fair -$0.37 not positive; not armed.
